summary: Convergence does not apply to root nodes; prompted job template values can be set per node with PROMPT (parent workflow inventory overrides node inventory), SELECT is disabled until required prompts without defaults are filled, and credentials that require a password at launch are not allowed in nodes.
questions: Why is the SELECT button disabled when adding a workflow node?
Can I use a credential that asks for a password in a workflow?
How do I override prompted values on a workflow node?
Does the workflow inventory override the node inventory?
